claim: From 2014 to 2024, data centres added about 250 TWh of global electricity demand, while space cooling added about 700 TWh over the same period.
shortLabel: Data centres matter, but air conditioning grew faster
comparisonContext: This context helps avoid both minimization and exaggeration when comparing digital infrastructure with other demand growth.
scopeNote: Incremental demand over a decade, not total electricity use in 2024.
